docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $472.40 FILED BY CASPARINO ROBERT AS TO DEFENDANT CYCLE SOURE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-20-1992 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CASPARINO ROBERT IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CYCLE SOURE PLTF. FAILED TO SUSTAIN HIS BURDEN OF PROOF STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
